items.text: A quote applies the pair's spread and rounds half-even to minor units.
A missing pair is derived through USD; a currency with no USD rate returns 400.
An expired quote id returns 410 on `GET /quote/{id}`.
`go test ./...` covers rounding, spread and cross rates.
Stack: Go. (one Go module, standard library only)
Load mid-market rates for currency pairs from a YAML file at start (e.g. USD/EUR, USD/GBP, EUR/GBP).
`GET /quote?from=USD&to=EUR&amount=10000` returns the converted amount in minor units with a configurable spread (basis points per pair), the rate used and a quote id valid for 30 seconds.
Cross rates: if a pair is missing, derive it through USD.
Unknown currency or a non-positive amount returns 400 with a reason.
A quote correctly applies the pair's configured spread and rounds half-even to minor units.
A missing pair is derived through USD; a currency with no USD rate returns `400 no_usd_rate`.
Unknown currency or a non-positive/malformed amount returns `400` with a fixed `reason`, rejected before any conversion math runs (explicit test, including int-boundary and `-0` cases).
`GET /quote/{id}` for an unknown/never-issued ID returns `404`; for an expired (>30s old) ID returns `410`.
Quote IDs are generated via `crypto/rand` and verified free of collisions/predictability at 10k scale.
`/healthz` and `/readyz` behave correctly, with readiness failing loudly at startup on bad config (wrong pair count, unreachable currency, invalid spread).
`go test ./...` passes and covers: rounding, spread, cross-rates, validation order, ID generation, and the 404-vs-410 boundary.

Sign-off artifacts are **both** present: a README with curl examples (happy path, a cross-rate case, all three 400 reasons, 404, 410) **and** a passing deploy-time smoke check — neither substitutes for the other.
Error responses never leak internal state (file paths, Go error chains, raw internal rate values) — verified by inspection of all 400/404/410 response bodies.
Single pinned dependency (`gopkg.in/yaml.v3`) confirmed via `go.sum`; no other third-party runtime dependency present.

answers.evidence: fxquote.go:handleQuote (lines 294–301) applies `spreadBps` from the resolved pair and rounds with `math.RoundToEven`; verified by fxquote_test.go:TestP1_SpreadAppliedAndRoundedHalfEven (9054 expected/actual).

fxquote.go:rateTable.resolve (derives via usdRateOf when direct/inverse pair absent) and returns `no_usd_rate` when a leg has no USD rate; fxquote_test.go:TestP1_CrossRateDerivedViaUSD and TestP1_NoUSDRateReturns400.
fxquote.go:handleQuoteByID returns `http.StatusGone` (410) when `time.Now().After(sq.expiresAt)`; fxquote_test.go:TestP1_ExpiredQuoteIDReturns410.
fxquote_test.go covers rounding (TestP1_SpreadAppliedAndRoundedHalfEven), spread (same test), and cross rates (TestP1_CrossRateDerivedViaUSD); `go test ./...` passes (verified by running it).
go.mod declares `module fxquote`, single module; only runtime dependency is `gopkg.in/yaml.v3` (go.mod, go.sum); stdlib used elsewhere (net/http, crypto/rand, etc).

rates.yaml holds `pairs:` (USD/EUR, USD/GBP) — LOADED BY fxquote.go:loadRateTable, which calls `os.ReadFile(cfgPath)`/`yaml.Unmarshal` and is invoked from cmd/fxquote/main.go:main with `cfgPath = "rates.yaml"` (or `FXQUOTE_CONFIG`) at process start.

answers.evidence: fxquote.go:handleQuote returns `amount_out` (minor units), per-pair `spread_bps` from rates.yaml, `rate` used, and `id`; TTL fixed at 30s via cmd/fxquote/main.go:main (`fxquote.NewServer(cfgPath, 30*time.Second)`); fxquote_test.go:TestP0_ServerStartsAndServesQuote.
same as ITEM 2, fxquote.go:rateTable.resolve derives through `usdRateOf` when the direct pair is missing.

fxquote.go:handleQuote checks `isKnown` → `unknown_currency`, then `ParseInt`/`<=0` → `malformed_amount`/`non_positive_amount`, all with 400; fxquote_test.go:TestP1_UnknownCurrencyReturns400, TestP1_NonPositiveAmountReturns400.
same evidence as ITEM 1.

fxquote.go:handleQuoteByID returns 404 when id not found in `quotes.get`, 410 when expired; fxquote_test.go:TestP1_UnknownQuoteIDReturns404 and TestP1_ExpiredQuoteIDReturns410.
fxquote.go:newQuoteID uses `crypto/rand.Read` into a 16-byte buffer, hex-encoded; fxquote_test.go:TestP1_QuoteIDsAreUniqueAtScale issues 10,000 quotes and asserts no duplicate/empty IDs.

fxquote.go:loadRateTable rejects empty pair sets, malformed pair keys, non-positive rates, negative spreads, and configs with no USD-reachable currency, causing `NewServer`/`main` to fail at startup (cmd/fxquote/main.go:main calls `log.Fatalf` on error) rather than ever reaching readiness; handleHealthz/handleReadyz return 200 once up; fxquote_test.go:TestP1_ReadyzFailsOnBadConfig and TestP1_HealthzAndReadyzOK.
